newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-KELLER RELEASED FROM U.S. SERVICE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KELLER RELEASED FROM U.S. SERVICE.

text.p: Leicester City goalkeeper Kasey Keller has been given the go-ahead by the United States to face Manchester United for the second time in 72 hours in Saturday's premier league clash at Old Trafford.
The U.S. have agreed Keller can play for his club rather than travel 6,000 miles to play for them in a World Cup qualifying tie against Guatemala in Honduras.
The Americans need only one point from two matches to reach the next stage of the qualifying competition and will play Brad Friedel in goal on Sunday.
The move will also mean Keller not having to make another hectic dash on Monday in time to be back for Leicester's premier league match at Middlesbrough the following day.
Keller was in goal for Leicester when they knocked United out of the League Cup 2-0 on Wednesday.
